fixturePolicy: Repository public history only; neutral requests; no session or memory text

recordFields.name: v
recordFields.meaning: record schema version, equal to this manifest's v

recordFields.name: run
recordFields.meaning: one condition run

recordFields.name: task
recordFields.meaning: task_id(base, requestHash, checksHash); the only task derivation

recordFields.name: ledgerTask
recordFields.meaning: the run ledger's task for the lead's submission, read from the run's own Application Support; null when the run never reached the ledger

recordFields.name: fixture
recordFields.meaning: fixture name

recordFields.name: base
recordFields.meaning: base commit every condition starts from

recordFields.name: requestHash
recordFields.meaning: hash of the exact request text

recordFields.name: checksHash
recordFields.meaning: hash of the hidden checks, neighbouring check paths and protected paths

recordFields.name: harness
recordFields.meaning: CLI that ran every agent in the run

recordFields.name: mode
recordFields.meaning: condition requested; managed-strict is Managed mode with the strict-lead switch on

recordFields.name: runOrder
recordFields.meaning: live runs: position, of and sequence of this run among its task's arms; cache read and write depend on it. null for fake runs

recordFields.name: switches
recordFields.meaning: environment switches set for the run, name to value (the strict-lead switch for managed-strict)

recordFields.name: leadChanges
recordFields.meaning: live runs: what the lead changed itself, from its own session file: editToolCalls and delegateCalls exact, shellWrites a heuristic match over its Bash commands, changed a verdict naming its basis. null for fake runs

recordFields.name: actualChoice
recordFields.meaning: what a chooser run did; null otherwise

recordFields.name: simulated
recordFields.meaning: true for fake agent processes; never evidence

recordFields.name: outcome
recordFields.meaning: how the run ended

recordFields.name: failure
recordFields.meaning: why a run did not complete

recordFields.name: fannedOut
recordFields.meaning: managed: true only if the run ledger recorded at least one delegated helper; null for solo

recordFields.name: helperCount
recordFields.meaning: the run ledger's delegated rows for the task; must equal the helpers on the production record

recordFields.name: helpers
recordFields.meaning: per helper: agent id and checkout, relative to the run root

recordFields.name: delegationAttempts
recordFields.meaning: delegation requests seen from a lead whose condition forbids them: the runner's spawn channel, plus a live solo lead's array_delegate calls, which the workspace API refuses

recordFields.name: tokens
recordFields.meaning: uncachedInput, cacheRead, cacheWrite, output for the task, lead and helpers together, from the ledger through the usage page's derivation; each int, or null when unknown or not reported, never zero for missing

recordFields.name: tokensNotReported
recordFields.meaning: token types the harness never reports (Codex: cacheWrite); null in tokens and not a reason for incomplete usage

recordFields.name: usageComplete
recordFields.meaning: true only when the ledger task closed and every token type is known or not reported, with no row marked incomplete

recordFields.name: usageProblems
recordFields.meaning: why usage is incomplete: unknown types, the task's state, and the ledger rows' incomplete flags (noBaseline, reset, fork, noUsage, ...)

recordFields.name: usageRows
recordFields.meaning: the ledger's usage rows for the task: agent, role (lead or helper), parent, harness, model, modelSource, turn, tokens by type (null when absent) and incomplete flags

recordFields.name: wallSeconds
recordFields.meaning: Swift driver: time to answer as the usage page derives it, the task's opening submission to its close, null unless closed; Python subprocess adapter: the process's wall time

recordFields.name: activeSeconds
recordFields.meaning: Swift driver: active time as the usage page derives it, the union of every agent's turns in the task, null unless closed with every turn ended; Python subprocess adapter: the process's run time

recordFields.name: leadTurnsAfterClose
recordFields.meaning: Swift driver: the lead's turns that started after its task closed and that no helper result woke, which the usage page puts in no task and leaves out of tokens; Python subprocess adapter: 0

recordFields.name: afterCloseProblems
recordFields.meaning: Swift driver: the incomplete flags on those turns' usage rows, noTask left out (reset, noBaseline, noUsage, ...); Python subprocess adapter: empty

recordFields.name: humanSteps
recordFields.meaning: interventions; null until coded

recordFields.name: diffHash
recordFields.meaning: hash of the carried-over changes

recordFields.name: changedPaths
recordFields.meaning: paths the agent changed, added or removed

recordFields.name: tampered
recordFields.meaning: protected paths the agent changed, and unsafe entries

recordFields.name: checks
recordFields.meaning: per check: passed, failed, error:<kind> or noResult, written by the grading harness

recordFields.name: gradeResult
recordFields.meaning: grading harness verdict

recordFields.name: hiddenPassed
recordFields.meaning: every hidden check reported passed

recordFields.name: neighbourPassed
recordFields.meaning: every neighbouring check reported passed

recordFields.name: passed
recordFields.meaning: completed, untampered, and every check reported passed
